mortality_caveat: National period life tables, not Madrid-specific or small-area mortality; regional sensitivity remains pending.
terminal_age_policy: Exclude baseline ages 90+ and endpoint ages 100+ from the paired counterfactual; preserve observed counts separately.
split_barrio_policy: preserve_each_raw_barrio_membership; do not pick one parent
population_source_series: monthly municipal extraction, not the annual revised or legally approved INE series
EXT_definition: non-Spanish including stateless and unknown nationality, following raw-source documentation
